title: Lando Calrissian
franchise: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description:
"Lando's not a system, he's a man. Lando Calrissian. He's a card player, gambler, scoundrel. You'd like him." —Han Solo
Lando Calrissian swindled his way into becoming the baron administrator of Cloud City on Bespin, but the Empire loomed like a shadow over everything they had built there. When they arrived, looking to capture the rebels, he had no other choice but to betray them.
